Capabilities & Benefits · 01
Dynamic Corporate Transformation

A strategy-execution platform for the
whole transformation loop.

AXIOM diagnoses what is true today, decides where the company should go, drives execution through owned objectives and projects, and monitors whether value actually lands. Advanced analytics do the heavy work — and every figure stays traceable to the cell it came from.
The loop — four movements, one system
01 · Diagnose

What is true today

Enterprise and equity value on four independent lenses, a full ratio and performance library, financial health and risk grade, and a collaborative assessment of organisational effectiveness scored by your own people.

02 · Decide

Where to go next

Objectives and key results with named owners, your plan measured against five forecasting methods, your executives' stated priorities tested against what the analysis sees, and the moves that create most value, ranked.

03 · Execute

Make it happen

Initiatives and projects typed, prioritised and assigned — with named accountability, milestones, action items and a schedule that draws itself, each traceable back to the objective it serves.

04 · Monitor

Watch it land

KPIs against plan and target, milestone and action completion, transformation readiness derived from assessment evidence, and the gap between intent and outcome quantified line by line, year by year.

What makes it different

Your people, inside the analysis

  • Collaborative assessment across 13 categories and 78 practices, or 361 in deep-dive mode
  • Design your own instrument — choose the practices that count, weight the categories, add questions of your own
  • Anonymity protected by a strict minimum-respondent floor, enforced on combined slices too
  • Results sliced by department and seniority — see where leadership and the layer below disagree
  • An Innovation Hub routing ideas from anyone into the same decision queue as analytics-derived proposals

Intent versus evidence

  • Upload your own multi-year plan alongside your actuals; AXIOM never overwrites it
  • Five independent forecasting methods, each explained with the parameters actually used
  • Long-run variance: which line diverges, by how much, cumulatively, and the year the gap opens
  • Executive priorities recorded and tested against the risks the analysis flags
  • Your plan, your extended plan, and AXIOM's forecast valued as three separate numbers

Nothing is a black box

  • One definition per number — ROIC, WACC, net debt and EVA computed once and consumed everywhere
  • Missing data is shown as missing, never quietly filled in as zero
  • Every score shows the inputs, weights and formula that produced it
  • Every proposal cites the document and page it was drawn from
  • Enterprise-to-equity bridge rendered line by line, auditable on screen

Designed for how companies actually work

Few deciders, many contributors

Strategy, valuation and objectives stay with a handful of named executives. Assessors contribute feedback and ideas through a private link and never receive access to the strategic surface. Access is configurable by the administrator, page by page, so the circle of trust matches your organisation rather than a vendor's tier structure.

Works with any system you already run

A defined data contract means AXIOM ingests from any ERP or accounting platform through a structured template or API — no integration project before you see value. Re-upload each quarter and the model refreshes; changes made inside AXIOM are never silently overwritten by an upload, and conflicts are surfaced for a human to resolve.

Diagnose — the financial picture.

Every capability listed is live in the platform. The benefit line states what it changes for the organisation, not what it does technically.

Financial performance and ratio intelligence

The questions a CFO is asked in every meeting — answered on your own numbers, with the formula attached.
CapabilityWhat it gives you
Headline ratio setThirteen ratios on one screen: gross, EBITDA, operating and net margin; ROIC, return on equity and return on assets; net debt to EBITDA, debt to equity and interest coverage; current ratio; free-cash-flow conversion; and the ROIC-versus-WACC spread.
One definition per numberROIC, WACC, net debt and economic value added are computed in exactly one place and consumed by every other page. Valuation, risk grade and the ratio panel cannot disagree about your leverage.
Ratio explainerEach ratio opens to its definition, its formula, this period's numerator and denominator as actual numbers, and the statement lines those numbers came from.
Economic value addedThe spread between return on invested capital and cost of capital, applied to the capital employed and stated in currency: value created or destroyed this period, not a ratio to interpret.
Common-size statementsEvery income statement line as a percentage of revenue and every balance sheet line as a percentage of total assets, across all periods, so cost drift is visible before it reaches the bottom line.
Growth on a stated basisYear-on-year as the headline, period-on-period available, and compound growth across the full span shown separately with the span named — no ambiguous single “growth rate”.
Your own ratiosAdd the ratios your industry actually tracks, with your definition and your formula, composed from your own statement lines. Your library travels with your account across every company you run on AXIOM.
Your own inputsDeclare metrics no accounting template collects — recurring revenue, occupancy, tonnes shipped, billable utilisation — enter them per period, and build ratios on them.
Missing is missingA ratio without its inputs is never printed as zero. What cannot be computed is listed once, with the data it would need, rather than shown as a page of blanks.
Historical and forecast, markedThe last actual period is marked on every chart, and any ratio computed on forecast periods is labelled as projection rather than presented as fact.
Organisational benefit: the finance team stops rebuilding the ratio pack in a spreadsheet every quarter — and stops arbitrating between two versions of ROIC that came from two different files.

Enterprise valuation

What the business is worth — four independent lenses, auditable line by line.
CapabilityWhat it gives you
Intrinsic DCFEnterprise and equity value from your own free cash flows, discounted at a cost of capital derived from your actual capital structure, size and specific risk premia.
Simulated distributionThousands of simulated paths produce a full probability distribution of enterprise value — downside, median and upside — rather than a single point estimate.
Real options valuationThe value of strategic flexibility priced explicitly: expansion, deferral and abandonment options, and the flexibility premium over static value.
Market comparablesEV/EBITDA valuation on trailing earnings with a multiple you control, presented at conservative, base and strong cases, with the divergence from intrinsic value stated.
EV to equity bridgeDebt, cash, preferred equity and minority interest walked line by line on screen as separate signed items; the ownership-interest discount shown separately, never folded into the reconciliation.
Stress and sensitivityHow value responds to cost-of-capital, terminal growth and margin shocks — and which single assumption moves the answer most.
Three valuation basesValue your own plan, your plan extended by an AXIOM method, or AXIOM's independent forecast — each labelled, each distinct, never blended.
Organisational benefit: valuation stops being an annual exercise performed by outsiders. Management, the board and advisers argue from the same auditable number — and can see immediately which assumption they actually disagree about.

Collaborative assessment

What the organisation knows about itself — collected safely, turned into evidence.
CapabilityWhat it gives you
13 categories, 78 practicesA structured diagnostic of organisational effectiveness spanning strategy, operations, people, technology, risk and more, with an optional 361-practice deep dive.
Survey designerBuild the instrument your business needs: choose which practices count, add your own categories and questions, weight the categories to your priorities, and preview before you send.
Private-link participationAssessors respond without accounts or passwords; answers save as they go and can be revised at any point until the cycle closes.

Abstention handling“Not able to assess” is recorded as a distinct answer; high abstention on a practice signals invisibility, not missing data.

Participation managementInvite, remind, revoke and re-invite; track invited, in-progress and submitted; reclaim a seat when someone leaves the firm.

Risk, health and benchmarking

Where the firm is exposed, how it compares, and what would have to go wrong.
CapabilityWhat it gives you
Risk grade and indicator bandsInterest coverage, current ratio, cash-flow margin, leverage and ROIC versus cost of capital graded against published thresholds, with an overall letter grade.
Distance to defaultSolvency headroom expressed in standard deviations, with the probability of enterprise value falling below debt, and of cash going negative under recession conditions.
Published distress screensAltman Z, Z′ and Z″, Springate and Zmijewski — each labelled as a screen, each stating the population it was originally fitted on, so a score is never mistaken for a verdict.
Independent second opinionThose screens sit beside AXIOM's own solvency read rather than feeding it. Where the two agree, that is corroboration for the board; where they diverge, the divergence is the finding.
The failure boundaryRather than asking whether the plan looks safe, AXIOM solves for the conditions in growth, margin and financing under which solvency breaks — and reports how far today's position sits from that edge.
Enterprise health indexHow much of your achievable enterprise value you currently capture, and the capital-structure gap between where you are and the point that minimises your cost of capital.
Evidence-derived SWOTStrengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats drawn from assessment scores, financial signals and cited documents — each traceable to its source. Where the evidence does not support a claim, no claim is made.
Benchmarking and contextPerformance against sector peers on a composite index, with a custom peer set where the standard classification does not fit, and your own market and macro assumptions carried into the comparison.
Organisational benefit: risk becomes a management conversation rather than a compliance exercise — quantified, comparable, and tied directly to the decisions that would reduce it.

Decide — where to go next.

Planning and forecasting

Management intent held separately from evidence — and the distance between them measured.
CapabilityWhat it gives you
Your plan, preservedUpload a five- or ten-year plan alongside your actuals. AXIOM stores it as management intent and never overwrites it with its own projection.
Five forecasting methodsTrend extrapolation, driver-based build-up, damped smoothing, simulation, and a back-tested weighted ensemble — each with its parameters exposed.
Method explainersEvery method opens to a full explanation: estimator, inputs, assumptions, when it is reliable and when it is not, and the exact parameters used on your data.
Plan extensionContinue your own plan beyond its final supplied year using any method, anchored on your trajectory rather than reverting to history — and clearly marked as projection.
Long-run variance analysisLine by line and year by year: absolute and percentage divergence, cumulative five- and ten-year gap, compound growth spread, and the year the gap first opens materially.
Gap and variance analysisPlan against actual against forecast on the same axis, per line and per period, with favourable and unfavourable variance separated and full-year attainment projected.
Full statements with bandsIncome statement, balance sheet, cash flow and comprehensive income, each line carrying its probability band alongside the plan figure.
Plan attainment probabilityThe odds of hitting revenue, margin and cash-flow targets individually — and the far lower probability of hitting all of them together.
Export to your own modelVariance and ratio tables export to CSV so the analysis lands in your board pack rather than staying trapped in a tool.
Organisational benefit: the board conversation moves from “is the plan ambitious?” to “the plan implies this much more revenue than the evidence supports, concentrated in these years, on these lines.” Optimism becomes quantified rather than debated.

Why the numbers hold up · 08
Confidence, not credulity

Advanced analytics, stated in the open.

AXIOM is not a dashboard over your data — and it is not a black box either. These are the disciplines that let a CFO put its output in front of a board and defend it under questioning.
Governance of figures

One definition per number

ROIC, cost of capital, net debt and economic value added are computed in exactly one place and consumed everywhere else. An automated check runs on every release and fails it if a second copy of any of those calculations appears anywhere in the platform. Two pages cannot quietly disagree about your leverage.

Treatment of gaps

Missing is never zero

Where an input is absent, AXIOM shows nothing and names the data it would need. No figure is inferred, defaulted or filled in from silence — because a fabricated zero in a board pack is worse than an honest blank, and it is the failure mode that quietly discredits analytics tools.

Valuation

Cash flow, stress-tested against distributions

Free cash flow to firm and to equity kept distinct and never substituted. Cost of capital built from unlevered beta, size and specific premia with a distress-adjusted cost of debt. Downside cases drawn from worst-case distributions within an uncertainty set, rather than an arbitrary percentage haircut.

Forecasting

Five methods, and a stated level of disagreement

Trend, driver-based, damped smoothing, simulation and an ensemble whose weights are set by back-tested accuracy rather than by preference. When the methods disagree, the spread is reported rather than averaged away — so you know when a forecast is worth arguing about.

Optimisation

The best combination, found by search

Margin, working capital, capital intensity, growth and leverage searched jointly under solvency and feasibility constraints, returning the value-maximising combination and each lever's marginal contribution — a multi-variable problem no executive can solve by intuition.

Viability

The conditions under which the plan fails

Rather than asking whether a plan looks safe, AXIOM solves for the boundary in growth, margin and financing space where solvency breaks — and reports the distance from today's position to that edge, monitored between cycles.

Honest assessment

Anonymity that survives arithmetic

Results are suppressed below a minimum respondent count, and suppression extends to complements — so no reader can deduce a small group's answers by subtracting one slice from another. Department and seniority intersections are protected independently.

Document analysis

Cite or decline

Every proposal drawn from your documents carries the page it came from. Where the source does not support a claim, the system declines to make it — the discipline that separates analysis from generated plausibility.

Real options

Flexibility priced, not asserted

Expansion, deferral and abandonment valued against the underlying distribution, producing the flexibility premium over static value — the part of enterprise worth that a single-scenario spreadsheet structurally cannot see.

Data integrity

Versioned and non-destructive

Every upload is versioned and retained and the original file stays downloadable. Work done inside AXIOM survives later uploads, and genuine conflicts are surfaced for a human to resolve rather than silently overwritten.

The question AXIOM answers that a spreadsheet cannot: not what the plan says, but whether the organisation can deliver it — and what it is worth if it does.
